answer: The reef test I would run is Proof of unique background check clearance with vetting agency attestation: clearances the agency issued after checks across years, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that clearances the agency issued after checks across years — so privacy survives, and the orchard is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the yarrow of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
